description_en: Enables or disables the communication between cloud computers in an office network (formerly workspace). If you enable the communication between cloud computers in an office network, the cloud computers can access each other
description_zh: 开启或关闭办公网络（原工作区）内云电脑互通。开启后，同一个办公网络内的云电脑之间可以实现相互访问彼此的网络
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-office-site-cross-desktop-access --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-0682660000 --enable-cross-desktop-access false --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyOfficeSiteCrossDesktopAccess

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the communication between cloud computers in an office network. If you enable the communication between cloud computers in an office network, the cloud computers can access each other
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启办公网络内云电脑互通。开启后，同一个办公网络内的云电脑之间可以实现相互访问彼此的网络
parameters.name: enable_cross_desktop_access
